items.title: Polite noun past negative
items.pattern: N ではありませんでした
items.explanation: Complete the four polite noun forms. 雨ではありませんでした classifies weather; compare adjective くなかったです and existence ありません.

items.title: ですから: reason and result
items.explanation: So/therefore connects the supplied reason to a result. It differs from time/source から and from contrast でも or sequence そして.

items.title: で for means or instrument
items.explanation: Extends transport で to a means/instrument. Interpret the noun's relationship rather than assigning every で one English gloss.

items.title: に for the person asked
items.pattern: person に information を 聞きます
items.explanation: The asked person uses に, requested information を. Distinguish listening to a sound from asking someone in context.

items.title: Body parts with あります
items.pattern: animal には 足 が 二つ あります
items.explanation: The live animal uses います, while specified body parts can use あります. Possession of parts differs from the animal's own existence.

items.title: Current residence with 住んでいます
items.pattern: place に 住んでいます
items.explanation: 住む → 住んで → 住んでいます describes current residence. This first limited て-form + います pattern does not teach general formation for all verbs. で is part of 住んで, not an action-place particle.

items.title: に for residence
items.pattern: place に 住みます / 住んでいます
items.explanation: Place に attaches to the residence verb. Present location います does not itself establish residence; the stated future plan may use 住みます.

items.title: Returning in polite forms
items.pattern: 帰ります / 帰りません / 帰りました / 帰りませんでした
items.explanation: 帰る forms 帰ります, not 帰ます. Returning differs from going and the perspective-dependent 来る. General verb classes come later.
